caption:
Sometimes the sore part of managing is not the hard talk. It’s realizing your job is to ask better questions, not be the hero.

Save this if this part of management surprised you.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #womeninleadership

slides.headline: Nobody tells you that becoming a manager can feel like giving up being the <u>best</u> at the work you loved.
